technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (about 10 posterior ribs above the right hemidiaphragm), no significant rotation (clavicular heads roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic vertebral bodies visible through the cardiac shadow), whole thorax including both costophrenic angles included. Scapulae partly project over the upper lateral lung fields. An 'L' side marker with rotated annotation text is present at the upper right corner of the image (patient's left), confirming conventional orientation.

abnormalities.finding: Tortuous, unfolded thoracic aorta with a prominent aortic knob and tortuous descending aorta projected left of the spine; age-related, no true mediastinal widening or mass
Mild hyperinflation: lucent lungs with low, flattened hemidiaphragms, suggestive of chronic obstructive (emphysematous) change; no bulla or pneumothorax
Mildly coarse / prominent bronchovascular markings in the lower zones without focal consolidation, nodule, or air-bronchogram
Mildly prominent hila, vascular in configuration (possibly with small calcified nodes); no discrete hilar mass
Tiny linear radiodense focus (~0.5 cm) projected over the left upper zone, most likely an external/film artifact or small clip; no associated parenchymal lesion
Degenerative change and osteopenia of the thoracic spine and both glenohumeral joints; no rib, clavicle, or vertebral fracture

description_zh: 正面（PA）站立胸部X光，吸氣充足、無明顯旋轉、穿透度適當，左側標記位於影像右上方。雙側肺野清晰，無實質化、結節、氣胸或肋膜積液，兩側肋膈角銳利；雙肺略呈過度充氣、橫膈低平，下肺野支氣管血管紋理輕度增粗，雙側肺門略顯突出但為血管型態。心臟大小正常（心胸比約0.4），氣管居中，胸主動脈迂曲延長、主動脈弓突出，屬年齡相關變化，縱膈無增寬或腫塊。胸椎及雙側肩關節見退化性變化與骨質疏鬆，無骨折；無中心靜脈導管、氣管內管、胸管或心律調節器，僅影像下緣見體外衣物雜訊，左上肺野投影一極小線狀高密度影，可能為體外或影像雜訊。
